verdict.rationale: Railway's homepage directly claims that HTTP, TCP, gRPC and WebSockets are 'handled automatically,' and that public endpoints, SSL and load balancing are live from the moment you deploy. Both points match the no-separate-configuration part of the story. The evidence is a single marketing line, though, with no documentation showing all four protocols served at once from one service. Missing for 10: technical docs on multi-protocol exposure from a single service (e.g., TCP proxy vs HTTP domain behavior), confirmation that no per-protocol setup is needed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve HTTP, TCP, gRPC, and WebSocket traffic from the same deployed service without separate protocol configuration

citations.quote: HTTP, TCP, gRPC, WebSockets handled automatically.
